name: Tour Kit
summary: Headless React, Vue and Svelte library for product tours, hints, checklists, announcements and microsurveys, shadcn/ui friendly.
description: A headless onboarding library shipped as 17 composable packages (@tour-kit/core, react, vue, svelte, hints, checklists, announcements, surveys, analytics, media, scheduling and more) for product tours, feature hints, checklists, in-app announcements and microsurveys. TypeScript-first and WCAG 2.1 AA accessible, with pre-styled components that fit shadcn/ui; free in development, with a one-time licence key for production.
contains: 17 composable packages under the @tour-kit npm scope
product tours, feature hints, checklists, in-app announcements and microsurveys
headless core plus pre-styled components, router adapters, progress persistence, tour analytics
works with React, Vue and Svelte and any component library; shadcn/ui-friendly defaults
source-available under BUSL-1.1: free in development, one-time production licence $9.99–$299
